progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:28.1) introduces D, F, Gk, G, A, centred on Bb. Phrase 7 (1:49.3) introduces Eb, centred on F. Phrase 8 (2:21.6) introduces D, centred on C. Phrase 12 (4:05.5) introduces Eb, C, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Bb4 (475.1 Hz) at 0:47.0. It closes on C4, not the tonic (F4 → F4 → F4 → F4 → Eb4 → C4).
